description: OS Mastermap Highways Network - Roads is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Ordnance Survey. OS MasterMap® Highways Network is the most complete, detailed and accurate navigable road network dataset for Great Britain. It records the dimensions and accessibility of roads. For all highways stakeholders, OS MasterMap Highways Network is data you can trust. Coverage: United Kingdom. The portal files it under the publisher Ordnance Survey. Its tags are Transport networks, map, road, road network, road transport. The portal shows 2025-04-16 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
